note: Not a clinical guideline. Used for a blood cancer that has no built checklist yet (a cancer typed by the doctor and marked as a blood cancer, for example multiple myeloma or a myeloproliferative neoplasm): the Case File requires three core records only, a histopathology, bone marrow, flow cytometry or cytogenetics report (any one), a clinical note with performance status, and the question for the board (an earlier treatment summary is optional), labelled 'No disease-specific Indian protocol'. A blood cancer has no staging imaging record (the marrow and the immunophenotype take its place: night-v3 plan item 2.9); otherwise the three records rest on the owner decision R05-Q04 (17 Oct 2026), not on a guideline, and say nothing about which investigations this cancer needs: the treating team decides that. The cancer's name is kept on the Case File as the doctor wrote it (case.json cancer_name). Must be reviewed by the hospital Tumour Board before real use (clinical review); a disease-specific checklist replaces it as soon as one is built.
settings_note: One setting only: the records are the same whatever the extent of disease. The system never computes a stage or a risk group.

Guideline basis of this checklist: none. No disease-specific Indian protocol is built for this cancer; the four core records are the owner decision R05-Q04 (17 Oct 2026), not a clinical guideline, to be reviewed by the hospital.
